_note: Single source for the five principles. Run `python3 scripts/sync_principles.py` after editing; it updates index.html (principles.md tab) and about.html (accordion).

principles.title: Lead with evidence
principles.text: Investigate thoroughly, provide clear reproduction steps and customer impact, and make sure every escalation has an owner and next steps.

principles.title: Expand what Support can do with AI
principles.text: Build practical tools that reduce repetitive work while keeping human judgement where it matters.

principles.title: Make knowledge accessible
principles.text: Create useful, findable knowledge so customers and internal teams can get answers without unnecessary effort.

principles.title: Turn insights into action
principles.text: Identify patterns in customer feedback and translate them into improvements Product and Engineering can act on.

principles.title: Under-promise, over-deliver
principles.text: Set realistic expectations and earlier internal deadlines. If I promise an update tomorrow, I aim to deliver it today.
